//: The ts-lambda pack (ADR 2026-063): AWS Lambda handlers as an in adapter, and the Lambda app template. adapterTechnologies declares the `lambda` in technology: the @exposedVia token, the folder contexts/<context>/src/adapters/in/lambda/, the package export ./adapters/lambda and the feature role `lambda`. generatedFileGlobs write-protects that folder, every file of which is emitted from the feature contracts (TN-26-012 §6). workspaceTemplates.lambdas is the app a TN declares as `apps/<name>: lambdas`: one entry file per Lambda, bundled for Node with `bun build {{entries}} --target node` (the design's Lambda entries, TN-26-012 §10), because the Lambda runtime is Node (hence the no-bun-api lint).
//productSurfaces: What this pack lets the product be used from (ADR 2026-065). bounded init maps the product spec to these surfaces and selects the pack that serves each needed one.

adapterTechnologies.description: One Lambda handler factory per feature tagged @exposedVia lambda, bundled for the Node runtime by the lambdas app

//generatedFileGlobs: The Lambda in adapter, and the Lambda app's composition root (ADR 2026-067), are generated from the design.

lambdas.description: A Lambda app: src/<feature>.ts per Lambda exports `handler`, built once per cold start from the generated src/composition-root.ts; the build bundles exactly those entries for Node.

//tnExampleWorkspaces: The app this pack's template makes, as bounded init shows it in the example workspaces map of docs/tn/README.md.
